summary.text: Shaun Mena is a Democratic member of the Louisiana House of Representatives, representing District 23 (Orleans Parish), and was elected in 2023, according to the official House member page.

paragraphs.text: The member page lists Shaun Mena's occupation as Attorney.
It lists education as Warren Easton Fundamental High School, 2000; B.A., Political Science, Louisiana State University, 2004; J.D., Southern University Law Center.

The page lists committee assignments including Commerce, Insurance, Labor and Industrial Relations, and the House Executive Committee, and caucus affiliations including the Democratic Caucus, the Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus and the Orleans Delegation.
